_comment: Version-source descriptor for Check-ReleaseTag.ps1 (the versioning module close-gate, COD-11). Birth-time file: point versionSourceFile + versionSourcePattern at the single SemVer source of truth, with ONE capture group around the X.Y.Z literal. Examples: a header '#define FOO_VERSION "1.2.3"' -> file 'Source/Foo/FooVersion.h', pattern 'FOO_VERSION\s+"([^"]+)"'; a manifest field -> pattern '"VersionName"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"'. changelogPath defaults to CHANGELOG.md. Part of the dormant/JIT versioning set - stand it up when the project gains a downstream consumer; until then this file (and the tool) need not exist.
